email.subject: RE: KVP-RFQ-26-0311 - DFM feedback on KVP-SPC-2408 Rev X1 Fiber Array Unit 24ch 127um 8deg, 2x MPO-12 APC pigtail (LPC NPI-26-097)
email.body:
Dear Dr. Priya Raman,

Thank you for KVP-RFQ-26-0311 and KVP-SPC-2408 Rev X1. Our DFM review against LPC-QM-021 and LPC-LL-003 is complete; 4 items need your decision:

 1. [R-03] Core pitch ± 0.3 µm on 24 channels (risk: Medium)
    Your requirement: 127.0 ± 0.3 µm adjacent pitch, 24 ch
    LPC capability  : Standard substrates ± 0.5 µm; ± 0.3 µm needs grade A substrates. (QM-021 §4.1; QM-021 §11.1)
    LPC proposal    : 127.0 ± 0.5 µm with a new 24-groove grade STD substrate.
    Impact          : 待工程師填寫

 2. [R-04] Cumulative pitch ≤ 0.6 µm over 24 ch (risk: Medium)
    Your requirement: Cumulative error ≤ 0.6 µm; absolute ± 0.8 µm
    LPC capability  : Cumulative pitch ≤ 1.0 µm standard, ≤ 0.8 µm best. Absolute core position ± 0.8 µm standard. (QM-021 §4.1)
    LPC proposal    : Cumulative ≤ 0.8 µm with incoming groove measurement of each substrate lot; absolute ± 0.8 µm.
    Impact          : 待工程師填寫

 3. [R-02] Borosilicate lid on fused-silica substrate (risk: Medium)
    Your requirement: Borosilicate lid (lowest cost)
    LPC capability  : Lid and substrate of different glass fail extended thermal cycling (CTE mismatch); R-09 asks for 1000 cycles. (LL-003 LL-01; LL-003 DR-01)
    LPC proposal    : Fused-silica lid (same glass as the substrate).
    Impact          : 待工程師填寫

 4. [R-15] Samples in 4 weeks / 2,000 pcs by 2026-10-16 (risk: High)
    Your requirement: 100 samples in 4 weeks; 2,000 pcs by 2026-10-16
    LPC capability  : New substrate design 5 weeks; first samples 3-4 weeks. (QM-021 §10)
    LPC proposal    : 待工程師填寫
    Impact          : 待工程師填寫

Target price USD 105.00 per pc noted; NRE quoted separately.

Best regards,
--
Alex Lin
Senior NPI Engineer
Lumora Photonics Co., Ltd.
No. 12, Lixing 6th Rd., East Dist., Hsinchu Science Park, Hsinchu City 300, Taiwan
Tel +886-3-578-6600 ext. 3216 | alex.lin@lumora-photonics.com.tw
